entries.title: Hebrews 1:1
segments:
Divers portions. The Old Testament prophets received only partial revelations from God; to none of them was given a vision of all the truth.
 

 
 Divers manners. The truth being many-sided came in many ways, directly from God or through holy men and women of different capabilities. It was revealed in dream, vision, command, prophecy, or through the instrumentality of a legal code.  It sometimes came in the form of promised blessings, and of warnings.  Its human agents were taken from many different positions and occupations.

entries.title: Hebrews 1:2
segments:
End of these days. The beginning of the Christian, the ushering in of the true Messianic kingdom.
 

 
 Worlds.  All things; the material universe.

entries.title: Hebrews 1:3
segments:
Effulgence of his glory. A new vision of the glory of God, as sunlight proceeding from the sun.
 

 
 Very image of his substance. The exact reproduction of the divine nature.
 

 
 Purification. Washing away, cleansing.  See

entries.title: Hebrews 1:5
segments: Son. No angel is ever spoken of in either the Old or the New Testament in the sense here meant in the quotation from
, which applies to the messiah, the Son of God.  On the contrary, angels are commanded to worship the Son.

entries.title: Hebrews 1:8
segments: Thy throne, O God, is for ever. In this quotation from
Jesus Christ is addressed as God, and the eternity of his dominion is contrasted with that of angels.

entries.title: Hebrews 1:9
segments:
Anointed. As a king.
 

 
 Thy fellows. The angels.

entries.title: Hebrews 1:12
segments: Thy years shall not fail. Thou are eternal and everlasting.

entries.title: Hebrews 1:14
segments: Ministering spirits. Servants of God and of Christ, in behalf of those who accept salvation.
